description: This Java interface defines a functional contract for writing data to an OutputStream, used within the OpenMRS project for streaming data operations without loading entire data contents into memory. It includes licensing, package declaration, and a single method 'write' that accepts an OutputStream and may throw IOException.

classes.name: StreamDataWriter
classes.description: A functional interface for writing data to an OutputStream, intended for use within OpenMRS streaming data service.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the provided OutputStream, may throw IOException.
